scope_original_addition: Work on one dependency-ready GT Lifecycle Lab task at a time with a single worker. The root AGENTS.md and DEV_SPEC.md govern execution; TASKS.md is the sole task and dependency ledger, and ACCEPTANCE.md defines the gates. Commit and freeze the current task's scope, inputs, expected results and required acceptance steps before application code. M0-00 only bootstraps the existing dsh binding and root rules; do not import or run RAG or implement the viewer during bootstrap. Execute FE-BASE and FE-INTEGRATE in M0, and RAG-BASE and RAG-INTEGRATE in M1, following the exact dependencies in TASKS.md. Fully clone the pinned upstreams and import their complete trees through git subtree only in the corresponding task. Preserve provenance and licenses; do not enable upstream skills or overwrite root rules. Use the Vue shell with the same-origin /viewer iframe and the actual RAG MCP entry python -m src.mcp_server.server. Finish, verify and lock each task before expanding scope. Preserve and continue the complete M0–M4 goal when dependencies are ready. Repair missing functionality and failures, report actual blockers, and continue within the user's existing authorization.
delivery_original_addition: For every task, report the task ID, criteria commit S, tested code SHA C, commands, exit codes, per-criterion results, evidence hashes, remote branch and baseline. Required SKIP, BLOCKED, FAIL or NOT_RUN results block acceptance. Do not weaken assertions or substitute mocks for required integration paths. Separate candidate code commit C from evidence-only commit E: E records VERIFIED, references C, and must not alter implementation, tests, dependencies, behavior-changing configuration or acceptance semantics. After remotely verifying E and its baseline tag, which must not be overwritten, use a bookkeeping commit K to record LOCKED and reference the known ancestor SHAs. Push K and confirm its remote SHA in the external Ticket receipt; do not try to embed a commit's own final SHA in itself. Mark a task checked only after all required criteria pass and the exact evidence and baseline are remotely verifiable. Before starting a dependent task, verify its prerequisite baseline is included in the actual working branch; a tag or open PR alone does not prove integration. Reopen or create a change task before modifying locked behavior, preserve old baselines and rerun affected regressions. Use the configured agent commit identity. Preserve existing repository merge and protection rules; do not add an approval gate for routine implementation or push operations, and do not bypass an existing one.
scope_project_addition:
GT Lifecycle Lab 项目适配（本轮仅保存规则和完成接入准备）：
当前准备请求不是真实开发 Ticket。保存配置、提示词或迁移文档产生的通知不是派工，不得据此创建或触发 Ticket、远程 Issue/PR/标签、提交、推送、上游克隆或应用开发；准备完成后停止。仅在后续用户明确派发真实 Ticket 后执行下文开发约定。保留完整 M0～M4 目标及依赖顺序。
唯一目标 shuyu-lin-dev/gas-turbine-lifecycle-lab；主 checkout /home/lsy/workspace/lab/gas-turbine-lifecycle-lab；Ticket worktree 根 /home/lsy/workspace/lab/gas-turbine-lifecycle-lab-worktrees。maxWorkers=1，一次一个开发任务；不通过额外 Ticket/worker 绕过并发。prepare 分支最后一段保持 DSH_SUPERAGENT_NAME，任务 ID 写入记录与提交信息。
未提交的主 checkout 规则/资产不会自动进入独立 worktree。后续真实 M0-00 worker 在正式规则尚未提交时，先只读主 checkout 的 evidence/M0-00/preparation/20261103T142014+0800/TRANSFER.md，核对基准和清单、应用变更包到自己的独立 worktree，再按根 AGENTS.md 完成范围冻结与真实提交。规则提交并集成后直接读取工作树内正式入口，不依赖原交接包或原包归档。

Matt skills 后续调用约定：
先读根 AGENTS.md、当前 DEV_SPEC/TASKS/ACCEPTANCE、GLOSSARY 与相关已有 ADR、前置证据；确认前置 LOCKED 且实际分支包含成果。GitHub Issues 仅派工关联，TASKS.md 是唯一任务/依赖/锁定状态清单；Issue 关闭/标签不能代替验收。领域文档为 single-context（根 GLOSSARY.md、按需 docs/adr/），triage 使用 docs/agents/triage-labels.md 本地映射。
每个 Ticket 执行计划明确适用 skills。实质歧义用 grill-with-docs（grilling+domain-modeling），已确定要求直接沿用；术语/必要决策用 domain-modeling；模块接口设计参考 codebase-design；新增业务行为用 implement+tdd；缺陷/性能回归用 diagnosing-bugs；候选提交用 code-review。to-spec/to-tickets 只处理授权范围内确需变更的需求，不重新拆现有 27 项任务，不另建完成状态，实质调整保留记录和依赖映射。
以实际 worker 解析到的 skill 文件和版本为准，记录路径/哈希及相对引用文件；不更新全局 skills。实际 dsh 工具为 skill({"name":"名称"})；部分 skill 禁止模型直接调用，授权使用其方法时以文件读取加载实际说明并如实记录，不改禁用标记或假记工具调用。已安装不等于实际调用。详读 docs/agents/workflow.md；每项记录实际采用/文件加载或不适用理由。skills 通用默认服从本项目范围、验收、提交和人工合并要求。
delivery_project_addition:
Matt 测试、审查与交付适配：
在 S 冻结测试接口、输入、独立预期、命令、环境、证据与回归范围；既有授权和冻结决定直接沿用，不重复访谈或增设普通开发审批门。新增业务采用失败测试→最小实现→验证的小步 TDD；预期来自冻结规格或独立答案，不照抄实现。上游/文档/环境任务采用合适的来源、构建或实际运行验证，不写形式测试。浏览器、MCP、本地模型、Kafka、流引擎和持久化按阶段真实验证，Mock/上游测试不得替代硬验收。保留既有主动视觉/截图限制，具体必要浏览器操作按冻结范围核实，不以截图替代断言。
缺陷/性能回归先建立能捕捉原始症状的反馈循环，保留失败、原因、修复和回归。code-review 记录固定比较基准、merge-base 与候选 SHA C，覆盖当前任务完整差异，不遗漏未提交改动；规范和规格分别审查。支持子代理时仅作只读并行审查，不新增开发 Ticket/worker；不支持时串行完成两个维度并如实记录。审查/实测后若改应用、测试、依赖或行为配置，形成新 C 并重验受影响条款。
后续每项严格读取前置基线→提交冻结 S→按适用 skills 实现→候选 C→审查和必要实测→失败修复形成新 C 重验→证据 E→远程 E 和不可覆盖的基线标签→状态 K 登记 LOCKED→推送 K 并在外部 Ticket 回执核实 SHA→交付 PR 由用户手动审核合并→确认实际分支包含前置成果再推进。E 只含证据与必要登记，不夹带实现/测试/依赖/行为配置/验收语义变化；E 不填自身最终 SHA，K 不填自身最终 SHA；标签指向 E，旧标签不覆盖，K 仅引用已知祖先及已核实结果。FAIL/BLOCKED/SKIP/NOT_RUN 均阻止验收，TASKS 勾选只表示 LOCKED。改锁定行为先建变更任务或显式 REOPEN，保留旧基线并回归。标签/PR 不证明集成，需要合并时等待用户；Matt 的实现完成并提交后仍必须完成本项目实测、证据、远程验证和集成。skills 更新不得改变已冻结内容。
保留中文沟通、代理 author/committer、披露行、gh-owner 禁令、用户手动审核合并及既有保护，不扩展账号或 Policy 权限。本轮 preparation 不是已提交 S，不勾选 M0-00，不登记 VERIFIED/LOCKED，不虚构 Ticket、SHA、推送或远程验收。
